title: Q-FLEETMAP-second-tenant: ultrastable/second-tenant is not equal to its source (72 file(s) differ, 71 missing, 0 only in the copy)
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** fleetmap --drift --apply (daily in tenant-sync.yml)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation fleetmap --probe second-tenant
**Prediction:** fleet_map_drifted_repos <= 0 within 168 h
**Status:** open

ultrastable/second-tenant is a copy and is not equal to its source (FLEET-MAP-1): 72 file(s) differ, 71 missing, 0 only in the copy.

- differ: .github/copilot-instructions.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, agents/AGENTS.md, agents/roles/customer-success.md, agents/roles/design-manager.md, agents/roles/funding-manager.md, agents/roles/infrastructure-manager.md, agents/roles/legal-ip-manager.md, agents/roles/marketing-manager.md, agents/roles/operations.md, agents/roles/org-designer.md ...
- missing: .devcontainer/devcontainer.json, .editorconfig, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/start.yml, .github/dependabot.yml, SYSTEM.md, autonomy/managers.json, autonomy/schemas/balance.schema.json, autonomy/schemas/catalog.json, autonomy/schemas/cost-budgets.schema.json, autonomy/schemas/criticality.schema.json, autonomy/schemas/default-policy-pack.schema.json ...
- ultrastable.lock.json is missing: the kernel sync treats every changed file as a local edit and updates nothing

Fix the sync named in doctrine/fleet-map.json for this repository (never copy by hand), then the same reading closes this item.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation fleetmap --probe second-tenant
